clips.title: The story
paras: Stolen provisions for the Crossroads lie scattered among Razormane camps in the Barrens. A raided caravan left the settlement short of food, tools, and necessities.

Razormane quilboar raided a caravan carrying supplies to the Crossroads. The crates were dragged into nearby camps among the underbrush and dirt dens. Thork, the settlement's commander, seeks their return before the outpost runs dangerously low on food, tools, and necessities.
